md_terminology.publisher: Government of the Republic of Moldova
md_terminology.evidence: Terminology for left-bank administrative units and Bender: status must not imply sovereignty.

osce_mandate.evidence: Territorial integrity of Moldova and mandate for conflict settlement.

osce_varnita.evidence: Varnița administered by Moldovan local authorities confirmed in the June 2015 elections; historical evidence, not 2026 certification.

gov_security_zone_2025.evidence: Moldovan local authorities in Varnița and settlements in the security zone; infrastructure planned for Coșnița, Cocieri, Corjova, Doroțcaia, Molovata Nouă, Roghi and others.

gov_elections_2025.evidence: 2025: left-bank localities, Bender, Chițcani, Cremenciug, Gîsca are described as temporarily outside constitutional control; polling at Varnița, Cocieri, Doroțcaia, Hagimus, Copanca.

gov_dubasari_2026.evidence: 2026 meetings with mayors of Cocieri and Molovata Nouă; confirms active Moldovan local authorities.

gov_cocieri_2026.evidence: 2026 consultation with local authorities at Corjova, Cocieri and Molovata Nouă.

gov_dubasari_2025.evidence: Consultations about Corjova, Coșnița, Doroțcaia and Molovata Nouă services and local-government transport.

asp_dubasari.evidence: Legal units of Dubăsari: Cocieri/Vasilievca, Corjova/Mahala, Coșnița/Pohrebea, Molovata Nouă/Roghi, Doroțcaia and Pîrîta.

gov_corjova_2020.evidence: Moldovan local council in Corjova and Mahala; restricted movement and nearby Dubăsari under de facto structures (historic 2020 evidence).

gov_services.evidence: Moldovan public services and security jurisdiction around Cocieri, Corjova, Roghi and Varnița; service presence is not proof of control over an entire polygon.

cases.title: Bender/Tighina — official municipality vs de facto city
cases.reason: Bender municipality in Moldovan legal nomenclature is not the same object as the de facto urban/municipal administrative relation; do not replace legal MD hierarchy.

cases.title: Bender city locality, distinct same-name geometry
cases.reason: Same name as osm-r12463379 but different OSM identifiers; alias/geometry identity is NOT certified.

cases.title: Proteagailovca; municipal-vs-village scope
cases.reason: Existing OSM subarea and 7-way reuse; municipal boundary and village status require separate identity verification.

cases.title: Gîsca, Căușeni de jure vs Bender geometric parent
cases.reason: Geometric candidate Bender does not amend Moldovan legal Căușeni membership.

cases.title: Cremenciug, Căușeni legal locality
cases.reason: Geometric candidate Slobozia; retain legal Căușeni classification.

cases.title: Chițcani, separate legal and de facto representations
cases.reason: P9.0.2 contained in Slobozia; historic ACTUAL identity role chitcani_de_facto_administrative_representation must not be overwritten.

cases.title: Copanca, no full containment
cases.reason: Boundary touching alone cannot establish de facto affiliation; government 2025 provides services in Copanca.

cases.title: Varnița, MD Anenii Noi (first geometry)
cases.reason: OSCE attested local Moldovan administration in 2019; 2025 government local-authority meeting. Do not import as Bender subarea.

cases.title: Varnița, MD Anenii Noi (second geometry)
cases.reason: Same locality name, distinct existing polygons: do not collapse or infer identity equivalence from names.

cases.title: Hagimus, Căușeni, boundary overlap
cases.reason: Moldovan security-zone support and polling site, but overlapping boundary is not a parent assignment.

cases.title: Dubăsari Moldovan rayon
cases.reason: Official Dubăsari rayon and de facto rayon/urban administration are distinct. Partial overlap must be preserved.

cases.title: Dubăsari city, geometric candidate
cases.reason: Name Dubăsari does not create an alias with Moldovan rayon or de facto raion relation 1702215; needs source-level identity review.

cases.title: Cocieri on left bank
cases.reason: The 2026 government met Cocieri mayor; polygon overlap with de facto claim is not a change of actual administration.

cases.title: Coșnița on left bank
cases.reason: Moldovan rayon/local services with security-zone restrictions; no automatic de facto membership.

cases.title: Molovata Nouă, plateau Cocieri
cases.reason: Moldovan mayor and services confirmed 2026; Roghi must be separately reviewed.

cases.title: Corjova, commune not identical to Dubăsari city
cases.reason: Moldovan local authorities evidenced, but 2020 movement restrictions and proximity to de facto city mean blanket polygon-control attribution is unsafe.

cases.title: Doroțcaia duplicate-name geometry A
cases.reason: Moldovan local administration/service evidence; two different OSM entities with same name must not be merged.

cases.title: Doroțcaia duplicate-name geometry B
cases.reason: An alternative geometric representation; identity equivalence not proven.

cases.title: Pîrîta, security zone
cases.reason: Shared boundary alone cannot confer de facto parent. Listed in Dubăsari legal-economic localities.

cases.title: Căușeni rayon intersects proposed Nistrenia root
cases.reason: Retain official MD Căușeni polygon, including distinct localities Gîsca/Chițcani/Cremenciug; no crop.

cases.title: Anenii Noi rayon intersects root
cases.reason: Retain official MD geometry and Varnița parentage; no crop or remapping.

cases.title: Roghi, legal component of Molovata Nouă
cases.reason: ASP lists Roghi within Molovata Nouă; available evidence does not certify whole-village de facto control in October 2026. Requires OSM-to-ACTUAL identity lookup.

cases.title: Mahala, legal component of Corjova
cases.reason: Legal component of Corjova; no justified unique ACTUAL geometry/whole-village control finding.

cases.title: Pohrebea, legal component of Coșnița
cases.reason: ASP confirms legal hierarchy and 2025 security-zone listing; OSM-to-ACTUAL geometry unresolved.

cases.title: Vasilievca, legal component of Cocieri
cases.reason: Legal component of Cocieri, separate from de facto geographic overlap. Identity binding still needed.
